read_format_mode_note: Current widths, bases, quoted STRINGs and dynamic formats follow ../read-formats.md; earlier format exclusions below describe the preceding typed/text adapter boundaries.
scope: Explicit ASCII TextInput adapter, READ CR controls and generated-script text input

reference_basis.documented: READ lists destinations and CR may discard a line remainder before the next item
reference_basis.uncertainty: Python numeric/BOOLEAN token grammar, STRING boundary advancement and complete-response stores are chosen offline policies, without native runtime observations

implementation_choices.source: Explicit in-memory ASCII str, with CR/LF/CRLF physical lines and a persistent defensive position; no implicit input device
implementation_choices.tokens: Whitespace-delimited Python int(token,10)/float(token); BOOLEAN TRUE/FALSE/ON/OFF/T/F/1/0; validate storage domains per field before consuming later fields
implementation_choices.strings: Preserve current line remainder and blanks; a subsequent STRING advances a completed field boundary; fresh empty lines are real empty strings; enforce 254 characters before destination truncation
implementation_choices.cr: Leading/repeated/CR-only READ markers discard one current remainder each; markers follow STRING without skipping its next line; may finish an unterminated final record; no phantom EOF lines
implementation_choices.metadata: Optional line_breaks offsets count preceding scalar destinations; duplicates allowed; no extra callback values for CR; total scalar/marker count 1..1024; old scalar request shape retained
implementation_choices.failures: Reject malformed metadata before consumption; consume a bad token then stop with input line/column; no rewind or response stores after callback failure; retain earlier effects and ordinary cleanup
implementation_choices.cli: Mutually exclusive --read-text and --read-values, explicit UTF-8 paths with optional BOM; text remains ASCII; compose with joint-axis context

retained_boundaries: No controller FILE/device input, implicit stdin, binary transfer or format specifiers
Existing destination, ownership, numeric, initialization, POSITION, CONFIG and FOR protections
No native parser/status/error-clearing/controller acceptance claim; strict remains future work with internal READ rejection
